flow: Two-electron integrals and the DFT quadrature grid, evaluated once.
Every configuration of the ensemble reads the same integrals and grid.
The Fock matrices of the configurations combine by weighted addition.
Energy and gradient of the ensemble from the assembled matrices.

lead: Molecules with near-degenerate electronic configurations (breaking bonds, diradicals, excited-state crossings) are described poorly by single-determinant Kohn–Sham DFT.
REKS describes them inside DFT by an ensemble of configurations with fractional orbital occupations.
Each active space needs its own working equations, derived by hand; the largest REKS active space reported before this work is (4,4).
REKS Studio generates the equations symbolically for an arbitrary active space and runs them in Psi4.
